by
  cases s with
  | empty => rw [prod_empty, prod_empty]; trivial
  | insert x s' =>
    have h1 : ∏ x ∈ s', f x ≡ ∏ x ∈ s', g x [MOD n] := by induction s' with
      | empty => rw [prod_empty, prod_empty]; trivial
      | insert y s'' =>
        have h2 : ∏ x ∈ s'', f x ≡ ∏ x ∈ s'', g x [MOD n] := by induction s''
        have h3 : f y ≡ g y [MOD n] := h y
        rw [prod_insert, prod_insert]
        exact congr_mul_mod h2 h3
    have h2 : f x ≡ g x [MOD n] := h x
    rw [prod_insert, prod_insert]
    exact congr_mul_mod h1 h2
